relationships.subject: nifuroxazide
relationships.evidence_quote: NFX mitigates renal oxidative stress by decreasing MDA levels and restoring the antioxidants' GSH and SOD levels mediated by upregulating Nrf2, HO-1, and cytoglobin pathways

relationships.subject: nifuroxazide
relationships.evidence_quote: mediated by significant downregulation of NADPH-oxidase and NF-κB expression and suppression of JAK-1 and STAT3 phosphorylation

relationships.subject: nifuroxazide
relationships.evidence_quote: NFX mitigated renal inflammation and effectively decreased MPO, IL-1β, and TNF-α levels in the rat's kidney

relationships.subject: nifuroxazide
relationships.evidence_quote: NFX mitigates renal apoptosis by decreasing the expression of cleaved caspase-3 expression

key_findings: Nifuroxazide protects against indomethacin-induced renal injury in rats.
Protection involves Nrf2/HO-1 and cytoglobin upregulation and suppression of NADPH-oxidase, NF-κB and JAK-1/STAT3.
